answers.how: Whale length is approximately 773 px, giving 19.17/773 m per pixel. Near 1.0 s, it moves approximately 64.5 px/s.
The initial vertical extent, from the back to the lowest flipper tip, is approximately 202 px. Converted using 19.17 m per 773 px.
The whale's nose moves approximately 32 px between 0.5 s and 1.0 s. Displacement = 32 × 19.17/773.
